info.name: LI.FI Earn advanced Earn Vaults API
Get vault by chain and address

params.name: chainId
params.description: EVM chain ID of the network the vault is deployed on.

items.docs: Returns the full details for a single vault.

params.name: chainId
params.description: Filter by EVM chain ID (e.g., `8453` for Base, `1` for Ethereum).

params.name: asset
params.description: Filter by underlying token symbol or address (e.g., `USDC`).

params.name: minTvlUsd
params.description: Minimum TVL in USD. Use this to filter out low-liquidity vaults (e.g., `1000000` for $1M+).

params.name: isTransactional
params.description: Filter by whether the vault supports programmatic deposits and withdrawals via the Composer API. Pass `true` to return only transactional vaults.

params.name: isRedeemable
params.description: Filter by whether the vault currently supports redemptions (withdrawals). Pass `true` to return only vaults that can be redeemed.

params.name: isComposerSupported
params.description: Filter by whether the vault is fully supported by the LI.FI Composer. Pass `true` to return only vaults ready for end-to-end cross-chain deposit flows.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: Sort order for results. `apy` sorts by highest total APY first. `tvl` sorts by highest TVL first.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response's `nextCursor` field. Omit to start from the beginning.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of results per page. Defaults to `50`.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of vaults with optional filtering and sorting.
